scope: Concrete project failures and safeguards to apply before each new system; observations do not imply every caller or scenario is fixed.

lessons.failure: Repeated broad entity/world reads multiplied work during UI and placement interactions.
lessons.rule: Read the smallest authoritative facts needed, once per real update; scope invalidation and keep preview queries read-only. A high call count alone does not identify cost or establish a fix.

lessons.failure: Expensive initial settlement exhausted a cooperative allowance before any positive clock interval, starving simulation indefinitely.
lessons.rule: Separate liveness from work allowance; preserve complete atomic consequences and unadvanced elapsed debt. Measure remaining costs honestly rather than skipping simulation to satisfy a budget.

lessons.failure: Native test scene setup foregrounded its window and warped the user's actual cursor.
lessons.rule: Routine direct checks are headless; foreground native input requires a reported issue that needs it. A minimized window alone does not prevent cursor takeover.

lessons.failure: Catalogue presence, source reachability and handler receipts were mistaken for complete gameplay outcomes.
lessons.rule: Describe actual physical outcomes separately from implemented services, synthetic arrangements, static diagrams and unverified ordinary play. Never turn an unresolved failure into a passing claim.

lessons.failure: Cancellation and automatic demand could recreate player-cancelled work or overpromise existing freight.
lessons.rule: Keep player intent separate from automatic demand, reconcile against real custody, and invalidate/reopen intent explicitly. Idempotent repeated/late events must not create another physical result.

lessons.failure: Deferred UI work and old sessions can retain stale references or duplicate refreshes.
lessons.rule: Use scene-owned subscriptions, one finite pending wakeup, current-session lookup or generation guards, safe disconnects and fresh reads when a hidden view becomes visible. Do not add idle polling as a substitute for lifecycle ownership.

lessons.failure: The bounded agent runner hashed old generated .artifacts worktrees and builds during startup despite documenting their exclusion, delaying any worker progress.
lessons.rule: Make documented fingerprint exclusions executable and check generated-output churn separately from retained first-party source. Stop a stalled owned run before changing its protected controller; review a fresh contract rather than silently mutating an active experiment.

lessons.failure: The first factory direct check treated900 simulated seconds as enough for two sites sharing two haulers, even though construction still had30 real M11 in flight.
lessons.rule: Base direct-check waiting on actual travel, handling, workforce and queue semantics. When a verifier assumes an unsupported gameplay deadline, retain the failure and diagnose physical state before reviewing a new contract. Never accelerate recipes, grant resources or weaken performance limits to satisfy it.

lessons.failure: The factory walkthrough requested a100-unit M11 stock minimum while140 starting M11 already remained. Production correctly did not start, but the initial guidance could suggest missing ingredients instead of the already-covered target.
lessons.rule: Distinguish a minimum stock target from a new-manufacture quantity, existing coverage from physical availability, and historical production from present storage. Explain the authoritative no-work cause before suggesting purchases or extra labour.

design_review: Which actual event or command causes each update?
Why is each repeated/continuous callback necessary?
What happens on cancellation, replacement, destruction or a late duplicate event?
What observable player outcome demonstrates this increment?
current_priority: Gameplay/features first. Polishing, optimization and benchmark campaigns remain paused; fix defects that block the current feature or corrupt physical state.
